subject.title: [Feature]: Add JSON-RPC bindings for language-agnostic plugins

question: Should OpenClaw accept a first-class JSON-RPC child-process plugin ABI as public plugin SDK and manifest surface, and should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98005 be the canonical implementation path?
rationale: This is a new public plugin-author contract with compatibility, security-boundary, and availability implications; source inspection can confirm the gap, but only maintainers can choose the supported ABI and trust model.

options.title: Review the linked protocol-v1 PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed manifest field, payload shapes, permission model, lifecycle policy, docs, and tests in the linked PR.

options.title: Narrow or gate the ABI
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask the PR to reduce the supported registration surface or keep the runtime experimental until the long-term contract is smaller.

options.title: Decline the public ABI for now
options.body: Close the issue and linked PR only if maintainers decide language-neutral plugin runtimes should remain plugin-owned wrappers or ClawHub patterns instead of OpenClaw core SDK surface.

recommendation.title: Review the linked protocol-v1 PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the proposed manifest field, payload shapes, permission model, lifecycle policy, docs, and tests in the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the issue and linked implementation and has recent plugin SDK history, making them the best immediate owner for clarifying the proposed ABI before broader maintainer approval.
